opening.argument: The description presents a $30 gift-card giveaway, and the visible App Store and iTunes card package is marked $30. The title likewise offers a free iTunes gift-card code. Together, those details support an ordinary giveaway, not a financial-participation scheme. A redemption-code area is visible, but the video describes no payment requirement or request for credentials. The record does not establish whether the giveaway was fulfilled or whether the code remained redeemable; neither uncertainty changes what the presented offer asks of viewers.
